transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've just been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and completely empty inside. It’s been like this constantly for over a year now, about a year and a month. I just feel so heavy and tired all the time.
During this past year, have there been any periods lasting 2 months or longer when you felt mostly okay, or has the depressed mood been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. It has been there nearly every single day for the entire year and a month. There hasn't been a time where I felt okay, even for a few weeks, let alone two months.

During this same period, have you also had other symptoms like losing interest in things, changes in sleep or appetite, trouble concentrating, feeling worthless, or thoughts of death? If so, have at least five of these symptoms been present together most days for at least 2 weeks?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in things and really struggle to concentrate, along with my constant sadness and total lack of motivation. I don't have any changes in my sleep or appetite, or feelings of worthlessness or thoughts of death, but those other symptoms have definitely been present together almost every day for the entire year and a month.

Besides depressed mood, loss of interest, and poor concentration, have you also had low energy or fatigue nearly every day during this time? If so, were these symptoms all present together for at least 2 weeks?

I haven't really experienced significant physical fatigue or low energy during this time. However, the other symptoms like my depressed mood, loss of interest, and concentration issues have been constantly present together for over a year.
During this year, have you also had poor appetite or overeating, insomnia or sleeping too much, low self-esteem, or feelings of hopelessness on most days?

No, I haven't really experienced any of those specific issues. My sleep and appetite have been normal, and I don't feel hopeless or have low self-esteem. I'm not really sure why, but those particular things haven't been a problem for me.
At any point during this past year, was there a period of at least 2 weeks when you had depressed mood, loss of interest, poor concentration, and low motivation all together nearly every day?

Yes, definitely. I've experienced all of those symptoms—the depressed mood, lack of interest, poor concentration, and low motivation—together nearly every single day for the entire year and a month. There hasn't been any real relief from them during this whole time.

During those same 2 weeks or longer, did you also have either significant fatigue, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, noticeable sleep or appetite changes, slowed movement, or thoughts of death nearly every day?

No, I haven't really experienced any of those specific symptoms like fatigue, guilt, sleep changes, slowed movement, or thoughts of death. I've mostly just been struggling with this very low, empty mood and a complete lack of concentration. It's really just those feelings that have been constant for me.
How old are you?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. My mind has been so foggy lately that I can't quite think straight, so I'd prefer not to answer.

Over this past year, besides feeling depressed, have you had at least two of these on most days: low energy, poor appetite or overeating, sleeping too little or too much, low self-esteem, poor concentration, or hopelessness?

I've definitely been experiencing poor concentration, and my thinking feels so foggy that it's hard to focus on conversations or reading. However, I haven't really had any of the other symptoms you mentioned, like changes in my sleep, appetite, energy, or feelings of hopelessness.
When you say “low motivation,” do you mean you’ve lost interest or pleasure in activities, or more that it’s hard to get yourself to do things even if you still want to?

It is actually both of those things for me. I have completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy, and at the same time, I find it incredibly difficult to find the drive to start or finish my daily tasks or work.
